sql:
SELECT
  p.currency_code,
  COUNT(*) AS payout_count,
  SUM(p.gross_amount) AS gross_volume_local_sum,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN p.gross_amount
           WHEN er.rate IS NOT NULL THEN p.gross_amount / er.rate
           ELSE 0 END) AS gross_volume_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN p.fee_amount
           WHEN er.rate IS NOT NULL THEN p.fee_amount / er.rate
           ELSE 0 END) AS fee_revenue_eur,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.currency_code = 'EUR' OR er.rate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS payout_count_with_matched_fx_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.currency_code <> 'EUR' AND er.rate IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS payout_count_missing_fx_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN 1.0
                 WHEN er.rate IS NOT NULL THEN er.rate END), 6) AS avg_eur_rate_used
FROM payouts p
LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
  ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
  AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
  AND er.as_of = CAST(p.paid_at AS date)
WHERE p.status IN ('paid','completed')
  AND p.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.currency_code
ORDER BY payout_count DESC, p.currency_code ASC
note: exchange_rates gives EUR->currency rates (base_code=EUR), so local-to-EUR conversion divides by the matched rate; EUR rows are treated as rate=1 and always counted as matched, per the request. gross_volume_eur/fee_revenue_eur sum only matched rows (unmatched rows contribute 0), so the gap vs. matched-rate coverage is directly visible via payout_count_missing_fx_rate.
